name: TOXIC SHOCK SYNDROME
source:
Emma's sister Béibhinn is moving on with her life; onto bigger and better things as far away from Ireland as possible.

Sunny Australia, of all places.

Emma is still here.

How could she leave? Someone has to look after their mother.

It's all the same anyway. Wherever you go, people are people.

But when she's in her room,
all by herself,
Emma looks out her window.

From there she has a view you couldn't get anywhere else on this Earth. 

[From [url=https://nxcromantik.itch.io/toxic-shock-syndrome]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾玛的妹妹贝宾正在继续她的生活；追求更大更好的事物，尽可能远离爱尔兰。

阳光明媚的澳大利亚，尤其如此。

艾玛还在这里。

她怎么能离开呢？必须有人照顾他们的母亲。

反正都是一样的。无论走到哪里，人就是人。

但当她回到自己的房间时
全部靠她自己，
艾玛看着窗外。

从那里她可以看到地球上其他任何地方都看不到的景色。

[来自[url=https://nxcromantik.itch.io/toxic-shock-syndrome]itch.io[/url]]
